messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened PR #8422 with an autoscale preflight checklist for the Dedicated provisioning docs. Can folks do a quick pass? I want to add a clear, short step around tenant-isolation tags + SLA phrasing.

marco: on it. which section did you add it to? the 'Before you request capacity' checklist?

elaine: yep, right under 'configuration' bullets. it's currently a short note: "ensure tenant_label and isolation decorators are set before provisioning" — but i want to expand to include an explicit verification command and wording for SRE-friendly SLAs.

sasha: small nit — the current phrasing says 'may be impacted by preemption' which is vague. suggest: 'may be subject to preemption under reserved-pool eviction policy; see SLA table for latency targets and fallback behavior.'

olivia: quick YAML snippet suggestion for the checklist so customers can copy/paste:```
# example tenant manifest
tenant:
  name: acme-corp
  tenant_label: acme-prod
  isolation: reserved-pool
  sla:
    latency_target_ms: 120
    fallback_model: small-gpt-quantized
```

olivia: also add a one-liner command to validate labels locally: `rwdctl tenant validate --file tenant.yaml`

marco: can we add a short example for autoscale policy cooldown? people keep forgetting to set cooldown when they expect burst behavior.

elaine: yes — i added a brief example but it'll benefit from a more explicit table. can you draft a 2-row table for 'burst' vs 'steady' behavior examples?

sasha: i'll draft the table. also noticed two broken links in the PR pointing to the old handbook path — i'll push a tiny link-fix commit.

deploy-bot: PR #8422 deployed to staging docs site: https://staging.docs.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/autoscale-preflight (preview available)

elaine: perfect. after sasha's link fix + marco's cooldown example + olivia's YAML, i'll squash and request final review. target to merge by EOD. :thumbsup:

marco: putting a quick checklist here so we don't lose it: 1) link-fix (sasha) 2) cooldown table (marco) 3) tenant validation cmd + YAML (olivia) 4) SLA wording tweak (sasha+elaine) 5) run docs linter + preview (elaine)

olivia: FYI i tested the YAML snippet and rwdctl validation prints a warning if isolation unset. i'll add the expected output example as well.

sasha: pushed link-fix and a small SLA rewording commit. preview looks good.

elaine: thanks all — will merge after one more quick pass. if anyone wants to pair on the cooldown table ping me.

marco: ack, will add table by 1715552476.

elaine: updated — merged. will close the thread once post-merge smoke check is green. :rocket:
